name: Universal 12V Router Power Bank Mini UPS
shortDescription: Universal 12V backup power bank for WiFi routers and fiber modems.
description: A universal 12V mini UPS that powers your router directly from its built-in battery whenever the electricity goes. Suited to home and small-office connections that need uninterrupted WiFi during load shedding.
highlights: Keeps the internet running during power cuts
Compact design sits beside the router
